###Glossary of Media Queries

 Name | Extremum | Breakpoint variable | LESS variable ending
 ---- | -------- | ------------------- | --------------------
Mobile s only | max | @screen__s | __s-only
Mobile s + | min | @screen__s | __s
Mobile only | max | @screen__m | __m-only
Tablet + | min | @screen__m | __m
Desktop + | min | @screen__l | __l
Desktop Large + | min | @screen__xl | __xl
